title: 第15章 登台挑战第16章 全场震怖
content_zh:
只要在斗塔内进行武斗，每胜出一场，胜出者都够获得一笔钱财。
如果接连胜出十场武斗，更有资格挑战一方擂台主，胜出后能获得相当丰厚的钱财及奖励。
如果接连胜出一百场，甚至有资格挑战该地分塔的塔主，成为新的塔主，届时钱财、名誉、权势皆有，可被各大势力争相邀请成为供奉，获得丰厚的俸禄，甚至有资格名列上榜。
斗塔共有三大名榜，分别为人榜、地榜、天榜。
在人级武斗场战胜一百场，可获得资格冲击人榜。
在地级武斗场战胜一百场，可获得资格冲击地榜。
在天级武斗场战胜一百场，可获得资格冲击天榜。
但凡上榜者，无不是名动天下的人物。
因为三大榜单，乃是斗塔通过分析大赵王朝各大分塔武斗场内，无数武道强者的各种情报，最终制定分析出的一个榜单，含金量极高。
前往斗塔参加武斗者，无不视登榜为目标。
只不过，参加人级武斗，仅限于真武境。
参加地级武斗，仅限于天罡境。
以此类推。
因为天峰城领域内的天罡境强者稀少，因此此地斗塔一般都是以人级武斗场为主，就连地级武斗场都稀少，只有天级武斗更是天峰城斗塔成立那么多年来，只进行过数十场而已。
以秦玄目前的修为，只能先参加人级武斗。
斗塔共有三层，第一层乃是人级武斗，第二层是地级武斗，第三层则是多年难以开启一次的天级武斗。
参加武斗，需要先登记身份。
踏入斗塔，尽管不是第一次，但秦玄依旧为斗塔内的宽阔大气为之惊叹，处处皆是精美的雕刻装裱，且地处于寸土寸金的天峰城中央，由此可见斗塔的财大气粗。
当他来到斗塔登记处，立刻就有一名身材窈窕、容貌娇俏的旗袍侍应盈盈上前，脸上挂着职业笑容：“您好，请问是登记参加武斗的吗？”
“是的。”

这时候，秦玄已经脱下了黑袍，并没有刻意隐藏身份。
因为在天峰城内，小小清泉镇秦家根本不值一提，且秦家的手脚还没有延伸到天峰城内，自然不知道他来了天峰城。
见到黑袍下的秦玄竟是一名如此年轻的少年，面相若冠玉，剑眉星目，女侍应微微一愣，不过很快就回过神来，礼貌道：“请先生登记身份，另外支付十枚银币登记费。”
在斗塔参加武斗，第一次登记是需要十枚银币作为登记费的。
即便如此昂贵，但依旧有着无数武修络绎不绝。
登记时，女侍应同样嘱咐一声，务必不要以炼体境冒充真武境武修进行武斗，否则一旦出事，斗塔不会负任何责任。
因为过往曾有不少只是炼体境的武修冒充真武境武修参赛而被杀死。
另外，斗塔对于参赛者审核很宽松，只要敢来就允许上，别说是炼体境，就算是凡人来了，支付相应登记费就行了，反正出了事自己负责。
“秦先生，这是你的积分牌，在人级武斗场内，每战胜一场武斗便能够获得十积分。
相应的积分，在斗塔内购买商品也能够获得相应的优惠。
当积分达到一百后，就能够开启擂主赛，挑战擂主，只要成功，就能够成为新的擂主了。”
女侍应一边带领秦玄，一边开口讲解。
“另外，积分也能够在斗塔专设的商铺、拍卖场内购买商品……”
秦玄接过一枚玉牌，这是每位参赛者都有的积分牌，初始积分为十积分。
在女侍应带领下，秦玄踏入了第一层武斗场。
第一层，属于人级武斗场，里面空间相当开阔，共有一百座武斗擂台。
content_en:
As long as there is a fight in the fighting tower, every time a victory is won, the winner will be able to get a sum of money.
If you win ten fighting battles in a row, you will be more qualified to challenge a ring leader. After winning, you can get quite generous money and rewards.
If you win a hundred games in a row, you will even be qualified to challenge the tower owner of the local tower and become the new tower owner. At that time, you will have money, reputation, and power. You can be invited by major forces to become worshippers, receive generous salaries, and even be eligible to be listed on the list.
There are three major lists in the Dou Tower, namely the human list, the earth list, and the heaven list.
Win 100 battles in the human-level martial arts arena and you will be qualified to enter the human rankings.
Defeat 100 battles in the prefecture-level martial arts arena, and you will be qualified to enter the prefecture rankings.
Defeat one hundred battles in the heaven-level martial arts arena to qualify for the top spot on the heavenly ranking list.
Everyone on the list is a world-famous person.
Because the three major lists are a list that Dou Tower finally formulated and analyzed by analyzing the various intelligences of countless martial arts masters in the martial arts arenas of the major branch towers of the Great Zhao Dynasty, and it contains extremely high gold content.
Those who go to the Dou Tower to participate in martial arts all regard getting on the rankings as their goal.
However, participating in human-level martial arts battles is limited to the True Martial Realm.
Participating in prefecture-level martial arts battles is limited to the Tiangang realm.
And so on.
Because there are very few Tiangang realm experts in Tianfeng City, the fighting towers here are generally dominated by human-level martial arts arenas. Even earth-level martial arts arenas are rare. Only heaven-level martial arts fights have only been held in dozens of battles over the years since the Tianfeng City Battle Tower was established.
With Qin Xuan's current cultivation level, he can only participate in human-level martial arts fights first.
There are three floors in the fighting tower. The first floor is a human-level martial arts battle, the second floor is an earth-level martial arts battle, and the third floor is a heaven-level martial arts battle that is difficult to start once in many years.
To participate in martial arts, you need to register your identity first.
Although it was not his first time to step into the Dou Tower, Qin Xuan was still amazed by the spaciousness of the Dou Tower. There were exquisite carvings everywhere, and it was located in the middle of Tianfeng City, where every inch of land was precious. This showed how wealthy the Dou Tower was.
When he arrived at the Dou Tower registration office, a slim and pretty cheongsam waiter Yingying came forward immediately with a professional smile on his face: "Hello, are you registered to participate in martial arts?"
"Yes."
At this time, Qin Xuan had already taken off his black robe and did not deliberately hide his identity.
Because in Tianfeng City, the Qin family of Xiaoqingquan Town is not worth mentioning at all, and the Qin family's hands and feet have not yet extended to Tianfeng City, so naturally they don't know that he has come to Tianfeng City.
Seeing that Qin Xuan under the black robe was actually such a young boy, with a face like a crown jewel, sword-shaped eyebrows and starry eyes, the waitress was slightly startled, but she quickly recovered and politely said: "Sir, please register your identity and pay the registration fee of ten silver coins."
To participate in a martial arts fight in the Dou Tower, the first registration requires ten silver coins as the registration fee.
Even though it is so expensive, there are still countless martial arts practitioners coming to it.
When registering, the waitress also told them not to use the Body Refining Realm to pretend to be a True Martial Realm martial artist to fight, otherwise Dou Tower will not be held responsible if something goes wrong.
Because in the past, many martial arts cultivators who were only in the physical training realm pretended to be true martial arts cultivators in the competition and were killed.
In addition, the Dou Tower is very lax about the review of contestants. As long as they dare to come, they are allowed to enter. Let alone the body refining realm, even if they are mortals, they only need to pay the corresponding registration fee. Anyway, if anything happens, you are responsible for it.
"Mr. Qin, this is your score card. In the human-level martial arts arena, you can get ten points for every battle you win.
With corresponding points, you can also get corresponding discounts when purchasing goods in the Dou Tower.
When the points reach 100, you can start the main competition and challenge the main competition. As long as you succeed, you can become the new main competition. "
The waitress led Qin Xuan while explaining.
"In addition, points can also be used to purchase goods in the Dou Tower's dedicated shops and auctions..."
Qin Xuan received a jade medal, which is the points each contestant has.card, the initial score is ten points.
Under the leadership of the female waiter, Qin Xuan entered the first level of the martial arts arena.
The first floor is a human-level martial arts arena. The space inside is quite open, with a total of one hundred martial arts arenas.
